facts.statement: GameServer calls DecodeReplaceRequest and DecodeFenceRequest, whose implementations live in FactoryReplacementWire.cpp. That file belongs to sources_engine_ExternalAI, while the separate engineDedicatedSources list includes NetServer and selected engine files but does not include sources_engine_ExternalAI.

Build 5 is reported terminal FAILED at 2529 of 2532 only while linking spring-dedicated, with an unresolved factory_replacement::DecodeReplaceRequest reference from GameServer. The partially linked headless result is diagnostic only and not admitted; CTests did not run.

The headless partial result and the source diagnosis do not establish a complete build, CTest success, final canonical successor binding, native readiness, or runtime acceptance. HighBar and FSBar successor freezes remain dependent on the final Recoil source identity.
